title: Howler's Den
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.A wolf pack has dug a den under the woods northwest of Pinewatch Lodge, and it has grown too big for the game around it. Two of Marta Fenwick's hounds are already gone.

About

Given byMarta Fenwick
Level13
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring in the steps recorded so far.

Steps

  1. Talk to Marta Fenwick to get the quest.
  2. Wolves in Howler's Den (10)
  3. Report to Marta Fenwick at -281, -213

Rewards

Reward
Gold448
Character XP14,000
Quest points1

What Marta Fenwick says

Marta Fenwick: Runs under the roots, and more of them below? I've never known wolves to dig like that.

Marta Fenwick: A pack doesn't get that big without a strong leader. If you're willing, I've got another job for you.

Handing it in
